description: Send an offline conversion to Google Ads (OCI v17). Required creds: customer_id, conversion_action_resource ('customers/{cid}/conversionActions/{aid}'), access_token (OAuth), developer_token. Optional: login_customer_id (manager), validate_only. Stores the request + response in dr_conversion_sends.

account_id.description: If passed, creds are loaded from dr_accounts.ad_network_creds.google_ads

creds.description: Override creds. Shape: { customer_id, conversion_action_resource, access_token, developer_token, login_customer_id?, validate_only? }

name: dr_send_google_ads_conversion
